notes: «قال سمعت أبا عبد الله» names the Imam only in the words after the chain, so he is imam_in_text. The saying is Ali's own words («كان أمير المؤمنين يقول»), so Ali is the last link (rule 6). Both are read from the words after the chain, as owner ruling 2 directs; the two-Imam structure is the reading's most doubtful point. «عليه السلام» is left out.
